plan.intent: Add three optional settings to the Dagger module .dagger/modules/ci. The empty value of each one keeps the current behavior of den. (a) riskyPaths: a pattern with "*" is a glob that must match the whole path, and "**" as a whole level matches zero or more levels. A pattern without "*" stays a path prefix, so the settings of den keep their meaning. (b) authors: an empty list still refuses, and "*" accepts every author, in the merge rules and in the shepherd. (c) checkName: when it is set, the newest run of that check on the head must succeed (new rule required-check). With no checkName, the rules rely on branch protection, as before. The values in dagger.toml do not change. Fixtures go in ci:automerge-rules and ci:shepherd-rules. INTERFACES.md (Dagger ci Module) describes the settings. Chorus task f4bbad07, AEC bead aec-16x.2, PR 1 of the order that MintRaven agreed.
stop_conditions: A change to the merge flow in shepherd.go or automerge.go beyond these three rules: stop, and write the question in the PR description.
